The cooling problems we see most in this industry

⚠️

Mold temperature drifts, so parts show sink marks, warpage and flash.

⚠️

Hydraulic oil overheats and the machine alarms out.

⚠️

In summer the water cannot keep up, cycles stretch and scrap rises.

How we size your unit

✓

Capacity calculated from clamping force and shot size.

✓

Separate control loops for mold water and hydraulic oil.

Anti-scaling water circuit, no frequent teardown.

FAQ

What is the Cooling for Injection Molding used for?
The Cooling for Injection Molding delivers stable process cooling for plastic injection molding, extrusion, laser, and other industrial lines, keeping equipment within a safe temperature range to reduce downtime and scrap.
Can you customize voltage and specifications or provide OEM?
Yes. We are a source factory with in-house R&D and support custom voltage (220V/380V/415V), refrigerant, and OEM/private-label production to match your market.
What is the typical lead time and minimum order?
Standard models usually ship within 2–4 weeks; lead time for customized units depends on specifications. Minimum order is flexible — contact us for your project.
How do I get a quotation?
Send us your machine type, required cooling capacity, and voltage via WhatsApp or the contact form; we size the right unit and quote within one business day.
